headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.51
summary: Xbox Friends now sends real invitations, refreshes with the active account and adapts to the theme, and the What's New dialog no longer disappears on its own.

items.text: Keep the What's New dialog open until you continue.
Send friend requests through the bulk add API so the invitation reaches the other player.
Invalidate the cached Xbox session when the active account changes.
Make Xbox friend colors and the online glow follow the light/AMOLED theme.
